breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the integration method with the continuously varying axial force P(x) = ρ g A (L - x) and applies δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(A E) dx. There is no mention of replacing the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load. This matches the ground truth approach and eliminates the incorrect 'exact' concentrated load substitution present in the incomplete prompt.
